$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 0 \\ 5\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} \\ 0 \\ x_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}- x_{2} \\ x_{2} \\ x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}2 x_{3} \\ 0 \\ 5 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} \\ x_{2} \\ x_{1} + x_{2} + 5 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=2 \\ x_{2} &=3 \\ x_{1} + x_{2} + 5 x_{3} &=-1\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 1 & 1 & 5 & -1\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 1 & 1 & 5 & -1\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 2 & 3 & -3\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-1)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -9\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-2)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -3\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)R_{3}\end{aligned}

$$
